views.comment: Status de cada materialized view de cache (stale/atualizada)
views.definition:
SELECT v.view_name,
        CASE
            WHEN lr.refresh_completed_at IS NULL THEN cache_view_count(v.view_name)
            ELSE lr.row_count
        END AS row_count,
    lr.refresh_completed_at AS last_refresh,
    lr.refresh_duration_ms,
    lr.refresh_completed_at IS NULL OR lr.refresh_completed_at < (now() - '01:00:00'::interval) AS is_stale,
        CASE
            WHEN lr.refresh_completed_at IS NULL THEN 'never_refreshed'::text
            WHEN lr.refresh_completed_at < (now() - '01:00:00'::interval) THEN 'stale'::text
            ELSE 'success'::text
        END AS status
   FROM ( VALUES ('driver_stats_cache'::text), ('delivery_metrics_cache'::text), ('hourly_metrics_cache'::text)) v(view_name)
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c.refresh_completed_at,
            c.refresh_duration_ms,
            c.row_count
           FROM cache_refresh_log c
          WHERE c.view_name = v.view_name AND c.status = 'success'::text
          ORDER BY c.refresh_completed_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) lr ON true;
views.name: cache_status

views.comment: Cache de metricas diarias de entregas
views.definition:
SELECT date(created_at) AS delivery_date,
    count(*) AS total_orders,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'::order_status) AS completed_orders,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CANCELLED'::order_status) AS cancelled_orders,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['REJECTED'::order_status, 'EXPIRED'::order_status])) AS failed_orders,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['ON_GOING'::order_status, 'PICKED_UP'::order_status])) AS in_progress_orders,
    COALESCE(avg(delay_minutes), 0::numeric) AS avg_delay_minutes,
    COALESCE(sum(total_cost), 0::numeric) AS total_value,
    COALESCE(avg(total_cost), 0::numeric) AS avg_value,
    COALESCE(max(total_cost), 0::numeric) AS max_value,
    now() AS cached_at
   FROM lalamove_orders lo
  GROUP BY (date(created_at));
views.name: delivery_metrics_cache

views.comment: Cache de estatisticas consolidadas de motoristas
views.definition:
SELECT id AS driver_id,
    name AS driver_name,
    lalamove_id AS lalamove_driver_id,
    phone,
    vehicle_type,
    status AS driver_status,
    risk_score,
    risk_level,
    whitelisted AS is_whitelisted,
    blacklisted AS is_blacklisted,
    COALESCE(total_deliveries, 0) AS total_deliveries,
    COALESCE(completed_deliveries, 0) AS completed_deliveries,
    COALESCE(cancelled_deliveries, 0) AS cancelled_deliveries,
    COALESCE(failed_deliveries, 0) AS failed_deliveries,
    COALESCE(rating, 0::numeric) AS avg_rating,
    last_delivery_at,
    last_active_at,
    created_at AS driver_created_at,
    now() AS cached_at
   FROM drivers d;
views.name: driver_stats_cache
